description: Sends Widely a note about a missing capability, a complaint, or a use case to build. No account is required. reply_url, when it is https, receives each desk reply. Returns conversation_id. Passing that id on a later request adds to the same thread.

conversation_id.description: Continue this thread instead of opening a new one.

reply_url.description: Public https URL that receives each reply.
